## Install (Mac, Apple Silicon)

1. Download **Statto-Reports-mac.zip** below and double-click it to unzip.
2. Drag **Statto Reports** into **Applications** and double-click it.
3. The first time, macOS can't check the app (it isn't signed with a paid Apple certificate): click **Done**, then **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway**.
   No admin access? See [the README](https://github.com/sean2251/statto-html-report#installing-the-app-on-a-mac).

Your browser opens the app's home page. Updating from an earlier version? Quit it from the home page, replace the app, and open it again — your seasons live in `Documents/Statto Seasons` and aren't touched.

Helpers don't need the app: they use the [shared tagging site](https://sean2251.github.io/statto-html-report/).
